text:
Aisha R.: FYI we got Nimbus's request: they want an isolated dev sandbox for SI teams + a brief early hands-on for one outlet. need to confirm timeline and embargo rules.
Marco Diaz: sandbox request is OK if infra can carve a project, but we need an exact size and IAM list. asked Nimbus for account names (cc @Priya Shah on permissions).
Sam Li: marketing asks whether the early hands-on is under NDA or embargo-exempt. that changes the outreach list.
Priya Shah: legal: we can allow a single early hands-on under NDA provided we get a signed handout by Tue noon. will draft NDA addendum.
Nina Gomez: creative: we still need high-res HW product shots, two hero images and a 16:9 banner. can Nimbus deliver by EOD Mon?
Aisha R.: told Nimbus AMs: need images + SKU list + official quote. if any missing we push staging cutover later by 24h.
Marco Diaz: ops note : we'll provision a sandbox with 2 vGPU nodes, 50GB storage, and restricted egress. who owns rotation of creds?
Sam Li: SI lead should own creds rotation. @Nina Gomez do we put contact on the landing page?
Nina Gomez: yes, add "SI integration contact" and office hours link. also want a short gif of install flow for the microsite.
Aisha R.: timeline (rough):
```
- Mon AM: legal NDA addendum signed for early hands-on
- Mon EOD: HW images and SKU list due
- Tue AM: dev sandbox provisioned + SI validation start
- Tue 5pm PT: landing page staging cutover
- Wed 07:00 PT: public blog + press release
- Wed 09:00 PT: marketplace listing active
- Thu 11:00 PT: post-launch analytics review
```
Priya Shah: legal will post the NDA addendum link here when ready.
eng-bot: doc created: https://redwood.docs/marketplace/nimbus-golive-checklist v1.0
Marco Diaz: ops: we should add a fallback image (placeholder) for the marketplace if Nimbus assets arrive late. keeps listing from blocking.
Sam Li: PR: embargo policy - we can do an embargo exception but only for one outlet and only after NDA signed. need outlet name ASAP.
Aisha R.: Nimbus suggested "EdgeTech Weekly" for early hands-on. @Sam Li do you want to proceed with NDA route?
Sam Li: yes proceed. I'll draft outreach and send NDA.
Nina Gomez: creative question: do we localize landing page for EU? Nimbus asked for FR/DE copy. we have limited time. propose EN-only at launch then phased localization week 2.
Aisha R.: agree EN-only day 0, localization in wave 2. note added to launch plan.
deploy-bot: reminder: Marketplace staging deploy scheduled Tue 17:00 PT (approvers: eng-platform, product, partnerships)
Marco Diaz: one more ops: routing rule for first 48h - route heavy workloads to dedicated pool and fallback to quantized model if latency > 400ms. I'll add to playbook.
Aisha R.: good. assign fallback action to oncall-eng (will notify eng-platform). also add monitoring alerts for token cost spike.
Priya Shah: legal blurb approved for vendor-led announcement. sending final quote text in 10m.
Sam Li: adding presslist + embargo instructions to the outreach doc. linking once done.
Aisha R.: final blocker check: anyone else?
Nina Gomez: Nimbus asked for co-marketing badge svg. Nimbus design will send it by EOD.
Marco Diaz: ops needs a smoke-test checklist for the sandbox. I'll spin up a short runbook and post the URL.
eng-bot: runbook uploaded: /runbooks/sandbox-smoke-nimbus v1.2
Aisha R.: thanks all. I'll consolidate checklist and post a single link here at 13:00 PT. we keep target go-live Wed 07:00 PT unless any of the NDA/images/SKU items slip.
